Definition: Kibroth-hat-Taavh, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: The people lusted, and the place where they buried the lusters was named Kibroth-hattaavah, the graves of lust. They journeyed on to Hazeroth, but Moses later names the place again among the provocations of the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names the graves of craving so we will remember what lusting cost, and the name still preaches.
RelatedEvents: The Quail and the Craving at Kibroth-hattaavah
